Hi Austin,

Your memoir One Last Hit follows more than a decade of active addiction, from eight rehab programs to a stretch in Mexico among members of the Sinaloa Cartel, and then the long road to the life you lead now as a father of five. Hosting the One Last Hit Podcast to talk with guests about addiction, trauma, and transformation shows how much purpose sits behind the story.
